May 3, 1976
RE: International Amistad hydroelectric generators
Mr. J. L. Johnson, P.E.
Acting Chief, Engineering Division
Department of the Army
Fort Worth District, Corps of Engineers
P. O. Box 17300
Fort Worth, Texas 76102
Dear Mr. Johnson:
In response to your letter of April 22, 1976, the Texas Water Quality Board has no land use plans which might be affected by the installation of two additional hydroelectric generators at International Amistad Reservoir. While temporary water quality problems may result during the construction phase, no long-term water quality effects can be envisioned.
If we may be of further service, please let me know.
Kuch Colle
Very truly yours
Executive Director
